mainEntity.name: Will the same caregiver come each time?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes! At Franchil LLC, we understand how important consistency and trust are when receiving care. We make every effort to assign the same caregiver consistently so that our clients can build a comfortable and trusting relationship with their caregiver.

If the regular caregiver is unavailable due to illness, vacation, or an emergency, we will communicate with you and arrange a qualified backup caregiver to ensure there is no interruption in care.

For more information or to discuss your care needs, please call or text our business line at 254-322-9251. We would be happy to help!

mainEntity.name: Can you help with bathing and other personal care?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, absolutely! Franchil LLC provides personal assistance services, including help with bathing, grooming, dressing, toileting, mobility, and other activities of daily living.

We understand that personal care is very personal, so we work with each client and family to understand their needs and match them with a caregiver they feel comfortable with.

Please feel free to call or text our business line at 254-322-9251 to discuss how we can help. We would be happy to arrange an initial visit and answer any questions you may have.

mainEntity.name: Can I meet the caregiver before they start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely! We encourage families to meet their caregiver before services begin to ensure it's the right fit for everyone. We also schedule an initial home visit so we can get to know you, understand your specific care needs, and carefully match you with the caregiver who best fits your personality, preferences, and level of care. Our goal is to make sure both you and your loved one feel comfortable and confident from day one.

mainEntity.name: What happens if my caregiver calls in sick?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your regular caregiver calls in sick or is unable to work, we do our best to ensure your care is not interrupted. We have trained caregivers on standby who can often cover open shifts, and our team will work quickly to arrange a qualified replacement whenever possible. We will also keep you informed throughout the process so you know what to expect. Your care and peace of mind are our top priorities.

mainEntity.name: What are your hourly rates?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends with the clients needs but we work with the client to meet their budget

mainEntity.name: Do you have a minimum number of hours per visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes 4 hours is the minimum. Let us know if you want to proceed

mainEntity.name: What are your hourly rates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our hourly rate start at $30 per hour.

mainEntity.name: Do you accept insurance or Medicaid?

acceptedAnswer.text: Graceful Homecare currently accepts private-pay clients and long-term care insurance. Although we do not accept Medicaid at this time, we are actively working toward becoming a Medicaid provider within the next 90 days.

mainEntity.name: How quickly can you get started?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Graceful Homecare requires a minimum of 72 hours to complete the client onboarding process before services can begin. This allows time for:

A comprehensive client assessment completed by our Registered Nurse
Development and discussion of the individualized care plan
Caregiver selection and placement
A caregiver meet-and-greet
Review and completion of the service agreement and required paperwork

This process helps ensure that each client is matched with the appropriate caregiver and receives safe, personalized, high-quality care from the start.

mainEntity.name: What are your rates or pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our rates vary depending on the services needed, the frequency of care, and the number of service hours requested. We would be happy to provide you with our detailed price list, which includes all available services and their price ranges. After learning more about your care needs, we can also prepare a personalized quote for you.

mainEntity.name: Do you have a minimum number of hours per visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, there is no minimum number of service hours required. However, if you need less than three hours of care at a time, a slightly higher hourly rate will apply.

mainEntity.name: Can caregivers help with medication reminders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, caregivers can give medication reminders under the supervision of our registered nurse.

mainEntity.name: What services do you provide?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Graceful Homecare offers a variety of non-medical home care and personal care services designed to help clients remain safe, comfortable, and independent.

Graceful Homecare Services

* Personal Care Assistance
    * Bathing & shower assistance
    * Dressing & grooming
    * Toileting assistance
    * Mobility & transfer assistance
    * Assistance with activities of daily living (ADLs)
* Companion Care
    * Conversation & socialization
    * One-on-one companionship
    * Safety supervision
    * Activities and engagement
* Alzheimer’s & Dementia Care
    * Routine and daily-living support
    * Companionship and supervision
    * Personalized assistance based on the client’s needs
* Respite Care
    * Temporary relief for family caregivers
    * Short-term and ongoing support options
* Medication Assistance
    * Medication reminders
    * Assistance consistent with the client’s care plan and permitted scope of service
* Meal Preparation
    * Meal preparation and assistance
    * Support with maintaining regular meal routines
* Light Housekeeping
    * Laundry
    * Changing linens
    * Tidying client living areas
    * Light cleaning
* Transportation & Appointment Assistance
    * Transportation to appointments and errands
    * Accompanying clients to appointments
    * Staying with clients when additional assistance is needed
* Flexible Care Options
    * Hourly care
    * Extended-hour care
    * 24-hour care
    * Individualized care plans
    * CNA/PCA caregiver support
    * Caregiver-to-client matching

mainEntity.name: Will the same caregiver come each time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hello, each of our clients will have a designated group of caregivers depending on the specific care needed. An example, if a client requires 7 days a week 24hr care. The care team may consist of 2 people alternating shifts.

mainEntity.name: Can I meet the caregiver before they start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, of course! Meeting your caregiver before services begin is actually a standard part of our onboarding process for all new clients. We believe it’s important for both the client and caregiver to have the opportunity to meet, ask questions, and ensure everyone feels comfortable before care starts. Our goal is to build trust and create the best possible match for your needs from day one.

mainEntity.name: What happens if my caregiver calls in sick?

acceptedAnswer.text: We have a system set up where we have a list of caregivers that are on call each week for any call out that may arise.

acceptedAnswer.text: No, there is no minimum number of service hours required. However, if you need less than three hours of care at a time, a slightly higher hourly rate will apply.

mainEntity.name: Can caregivers help with medication reminders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, caregivers can give medication reminders under the supervision of our registered nurse.

mainEntity.name: What services do you provide?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Graceful Homecare offers a variety of non-medical home care and personal care services designed to help clients remain safe, comfortable, and independent.

Graceful Homecare Services

* Personal Care Assistance
    * Bathing & shower assistance
    * Dressing & grooming
    * Toileting assistance
    * Mobility & transfer assistance
    * Assistance with activities of daily living (ADLs)
* Companion Care
    * Conversation & socialization
    * One-on-one companionship
    * Safety supervision
    * Activities and engagement
* Alzheimer’s & Dementia Care
    * Routine and daily-living support
    * Companionship and supervision
    * Personalized assistance based on the client’s needs
* Respite Care
    * Temporary relief for family caregivers
    * Short-term and ongoing support options
* Medication Assistance
    * Medication reminders
    * Assistance consistent with the client’s care plan and permitted scope of service
* Meal Preparation
    * Meal preparation and assistance
    * Support with maintaining regular meal routines
* Light Housekeeping
    * Laundry
    * Changing linens
    * Tidying client living areas
    * Light cleaning
* Transportation & Appointment Assistance
    * Transportation to appointments and errands
    * Accompanying clients to appointments
    * Staying with clients when additional assistance is needed
* Flexible Care Options
    * Hourly care
    * Extended-hour care
    * 24-hour care
    * Individualized care plans
    * CNA/PCA caregiver support
    * Caregiver-to-client matching

mainEntity.name: Will the same caregiver come each time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hello, each of our clients will have a designated group of caregivers depending on the specific care needed. An example, if a client requires 7 days a week 24hr care. The care team may consist of 2 people alternating shifts.

mainEntity.name: Can I meet the caregiver before they start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, of course! Meeting your caregiver before services begin is actually a standard part of our onboarding process for all new clients. We believe it’s important for both the client and caregiver to have the opportunity to meet, ask questions, and ensure everyone feels comfortable before care starts. Our goal is to build trust and create the best possible match for your needs from day one.

mainEntity.name: What happens if my caregiver calls in sick?

acceptedAnswer.text: We have a system set up where we have a list of caregivers that are on call each week for any call out that may arise.
